data.body: 90e2 RED/GREEN/mutation evidence: initial behavioral tripwire run exposed an overspecified exact-error assertion, corrected to the real contract (failed status plus propagated cause); focused workflow suite is now green. Sandboxed mutation proof in session scratch killed two seeded defects: (1) a true retry-on-exception mutant in interpreter._run_leaf made test_executor_never_retries_a_failing_effectful_step fail with attempts=2; (2) a skip-rc.failed mutant in interpreter._execute_frame made test_executor_observes_raising_effectful_step_once_and_stops_downstream fail by executing the downstream step.
